question.worked_solution:
Since $43$ is larger than $6,$ the answer will be negative.

We start by solving an easier problem:

$$
43-6
$$

Next, we carry out the subtraction:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,3\end{aligned} & \,\,\,\begin{aligned}\,\,\,13\end{aligned} \\  &  & \,\,\,4\,\,\, & \,\,\,3\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,-\,\,\,\, &  &  & \,\,\,6\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,3\,\,\, & \,\,\,7\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
43-6=37.
$$

However, since our answer must be negative, we need to change the sign of the answer above. 

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
6-43=-37.
$$
